sources.title: π 0 : A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
sources.snippet: By basing our model on a VLM, we inherit the general knowledge, semantic reasoning, and problem-solving abilities of language- and vision-language models. We then further train our model to incorporate robot actions, turning it into a vision-language-action (VLA) model [7].
